artifact_partitions.rule: 00120 and delivery-zone assertions retain operator/UPU provenance, capture time, edition and digest; single-code syntax never creates geometry.
Only separately reviewed rights-cleared Polygon/MultiPolygon with complete zone/address/category reconciliation may be public output.
Vatican City territory and Holy See extraterritorial properties remain distinct sovereign/legal context and never create postal membership.
P.O. boxes, organizations, office locations, delivery timing and authorization remain service/recipient context separate from area.
Address and building assertions remain separate; no listed address or recipient is committed or buffered into public geometry.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
